item.title: PlugVault 0.11
item.description:
PlugVault 0.11

  • Show All from a manufacturer now scrolls the sidebar to that manufacturer and marks it clearly, in bold with a colored icon, even while the list is not focused.

item.title: PlugVault 0.10
item.description:
PlugVault 0.10

  • PlugVault now checks for a new version quietly every time it opens, as well as weekly, so important fixes arrive the same day. Nothing appears unless there is an update, and nothing installs until you say so.
  • Fixed: macOS asked again for permission to access folders or drives after every update. Builds are now signed with one stable identity, so a permission you grant is kept. (One more prompt after this update, then no more.)

item.title: PlugVault 0.9
item.description:
PlugVault 0.9

  • Fixed: with the license screen up, Quit PlugVault and ⌘Q did nothing. Both quit now.
  • Support: support@machael.studio in About and in a new Help topic; the website is at machael.studio/plugvault.

item.title: PlugVault 0.8
item.description:
PlugVault 0.8

  • An uninstall queue: right-click plug-ins and choose Add to Uninstall Queue, review the list from the Queue button in the toolbar, then Start Uninstalling goes through them one at a time, each with its own confirmation — licence reminders, leftover files, the administrator prompt — with Skip and Stop Queue at every step. The queue is kept until you clear it.
  • Comparing with a backup or another Mac opens in its own resizable window. Plug-ins are grouped by manufacturer and collapsed, with colored counts on each manufacturer, and manufacturers with something to install come first. Selecting a plug-in shows a pane with the versions on both Macs and the best way to get it: the vendor's own installer app if it is on this Mac, otherwise the vendor's website, plus a web search and store links.
  • Sound Libraries now finds Spitfire Audio libraries — BBC Symphony Orchestra, Abbey Road One, Originals, LABS packs and the rest — through the Spitfire app's own records, wherever they were installed.

item.title: PlugVault 0.7
item.description:
PlugVault 0.7

  • Install and Relaunch in the update window now quits and relaunches PlugVault on its own; before, the app had to be quit by hand. (Updating from 0.6 still needs that one manual quit; from 0.7 on it is automatic.)
  • A revoked key, or a seat freed from another Mac, now takes effect the next time PlugVault opens, or within a few hours while it is running. Before, it could take up to two weeks.

item.title: PlugVault 0.6
item.description:
PlugVault 0.6

  • PlugVault now needs a license key. Enter the key you were given when the app opens; it is tied to this Mac. Settings › License shows which Macs use the license's seats, frees a seat from any of them, and can deactivate this Mac before you sell or wipe it.

item.title: PlugVault 0.5
item.description:
PlugVault 0.5

  • The DAWs and Sound Libraries tables sort by any column when you click its header, like the Plug-ins table. Libraries start with the largest first.

item.title: PlugVault 0.4
item.description:
PlugVault 0.4

  • Fixed for real: All Plug-ins, All DAWs and All Libraries in the sidebar now work when a group is selected. The row also highlights, as it should have.
  • The sidebar tabs are now icons with the name underneath and on hover, so the sidebar stays narrow with five sections.

item.title: PlugVault 0.3
item.description:
PlugVault 0.3

  • Sound Libraries tab: the sample content your plug-ins load — Kontakt libraries, Omnisphere's STEAM folder, UVI soundbanks, Steinberg, Waves, Roland, IK, Toontrack and more — with size, vendor, player and drive, grouped by vendor with totals. Move one to the Trash to reclaim its space.
  • Libraries kept on another drive: if a player such as Kontakt or Omnisphere is installed but no libraries are found, PlugVault asks where they are. Add any folder and it is searched.
  • Backups now list your sound libraries and where they lived, and comparing with a backup shows the ones missing on this Mac.
  • Fixed: clicking All Plug-ins (and All DAWs) in the sidebar now clears the selected group.
  • The first tab is now called Plug-ins, and Sound Libraries is ⌘5.

item.title: PlugVault 0.2
item.description:
PlugVault 0.2

  • PlugVault now updates itself: a weekly check, Check for Updates… in the PlugVault menu, and an Updates section in Settings. Nothing installs until you click Install.
